summary: Procure Zoom Webinar add-on (100 seats) + Live Transcription; SSO provisioning and cost-center allocation
description:
Issue summary: Request procurement of Zoom Webinar add-on (up to 100 unique webinar panelists/attendees across scheduled events) and the Live Transcription (AI CC) add-on for Customer Success and Events teams. Impact: Upcoming Q3 customer webinar series requires captioning and webinar-specific licensing. Without add-ons, CS will not be able to host large webinars with registration controls or provide live AI transcripts, impacting customer accessibility and potentially reducing attendance or raising compliance concerns.

Desired outcome: Purchase Zoom Webinar add-on SKU for up to 100 seats (12-month term) and Live Transcription add-on for same term; map invoices to cost center/department 220-CS; enable SSO provisioning via Okta and configure SCIM group sync so Event Managers can be auto-provisioned; ensure billing alignment and tag invoices for Q3 events. Need procurement to obtain vendor quote, confirm seat activation timeline, and create PO.

Approvers required: Events manager (Maya Chen), Finance owner (Noah Rivera). Deadline: Need contract signed and seats provisioned by 2026-04-01 to support registration and rehearsals.

Vendor contact: Zoom account rep - Jordan Alvarez (j.alvarez@zoom.us). Estimated annual cost: vendor quote requested; ballpark expected ~$18k-$28k depending on negotiated discount.

Special requirements: 
- Live Transcription must be configured to persist transcripts to the Events S3 bucket with access control (see retention policy Confluence page link below).
- Transcription storage and PII handling needs legal review; ask Legal for short checklist before enabling persistence.
- SCIM mapping should create group "events-webinar-managers" and assign role-based access so managers can schedule and assign panelists.
- Single invoice on annual term preferred; otherwise flag multi-line invoice for Finance routing.

Related docs: https://confluence.redwood/company/events/webinar-security-guidelines, https://confluence.redwood/finance/cloud-software-onboarding

2026-03-13 15:02 - Finance (Noah Rivera): Please include preferred billing code 220-CS and indicate if prepayment required. Will expedite PO approval if cost under $30k/year.

2026-03-13 17:28 - Priya Desai (IT/Security): Note: Any transcript persistence to S3 requires Legal sign-off and an IAM policy review. Please provide retention requirements. SCIM provisioning must be limited to group membership only.
2026-03-14 08:27 - Liam Patel: Added requested retention details to Confluence (30 days retention, access limited to Events and Legal). Please advise next steps.

2026-03-14 10:00 - Procurement (Maya Chen): Reached out to Zoom rep Jordan A. Awaiting formal quote and reseller discount matrix. Will request sample contract with transcription data processing addendum.
2026-03-14 14:35 - Legal (Sofia Morales): Will review DPA for transcription persistence; expect review complete by 2026-03-18. Provide vendor's DPA draft when available.
investigation_notes: Checked existing Zoom account under Redwood (account ID Z-99821) — current plan includes Meetings Pro but not Webinar or AI Transcription add-ons.
Finance verified current vendor relationship with Zoom; procurement has existing reseller contact which may yield a discount if bundled with other org purchases.
IT verified Okta org supports SCIM provisioning to Zoom but requires an admin token exchange and a scoped service account. Need to coordinate with Okta team for token rotation policy.

Events team confirmed 100 seat ceiling; if attendance spikes above 100 across concurrent events, fallback plan is to enable registration waitlists and broadcast a recording instead of live transcript streaming to external participants.
sso_requirements: Okta SSO + SCIM group sync for 'events-webinar-managers'; service account credentials will be stored in Vault; SCIM only to write group membership; no user deprovisioning until SCIM-enabled in test tenant.
notes_for_procurement: Request annual quote, DPA with transcription data processing addendum, reseller discount, and confirm lead time for seat activation. Include billing code 220-CS on PO. If vendor requires minimum commitment beyond 12 months, flag to Finance and Legal.
